question: Does a locally runnable Qwen3-14B checkpoint reach receiver capability on the short PrefixSum task where Qwen3-4B/8B remained unreliable?
motivation: v0.11-v0.15 show sender success and partial direct receiver success, but no reliable simulator receiver completion. Before deciding that this task family is unsuitable or moving to message-format comparisons, test one stronger local checkpoint under a frozen protocol and separate direct arithmetic from simulator interaction.
task_suite: PrefixSum short-shard v0.3; paired reuse of the same 24 v0.11 cases
runtime: llama.cpp b11202, commit fcb3074f2, Windows x64 CUDA 12.4; RTX 4060 Laptop GPU 8 GB; 24 GPU layers requested with CPU offload; context 8192; temperature 0; 256-token server generation cap; API direct calls capped at 128 tokens
design: Two components with 96 scored episodes total. First, run the three v0.13 direct arithmetic-ladder conditions for all 24 cases (72 direct calls). Second, run an oracle-sender/model-receiver Silo-engine hybrid for all 24 cases (24 episodes) using the frozen compact-KV s=<subtotal> channel. One greedy run per task and condition. The 8B v0.11/v0.13 results are paired descriptive references, not a causal scale estimate.
direct_conditions: local_prefix: given Agent 1 shard x, emit its local inclusive prefix as a strict JSON integer array
offset_vector: given the exact local-prefix vector p and correct offset s, emit p_i+s as a strict JSON integer array
combined_receiver: given x and correct s, compute and emit the global prefix segment as a strict JSON integer array
simulator_condition: Oracle Agent 0 sends the correct compact-KV subtotal through the pinned v0.8 Silo message engine. Qwen3-14B Agent 1 must call receive_messages and submit its exact global prefix segment. No injected receive transcript in this condition.
primary_outcomes: direct strict exact integer-array accuracy by arithmetic condition and length
simulator Agent 1 exactness among episodes that received the correct oracle subtotal before submission
simulator receive action, payload receipt, and joint exact task success
secondary_outcomes: message receipt, sender syntax, local-prefix-only errors, and raw outputs
input/output tokens, wall time, rounds, model load settings, and peak observed VRAM/RAM if available
frozen_predictions: If direct offset_vector succeeds while combined_receiver and simulator receiver fail, the task requires more than arithmetic substeps and prompts a focused composition/context study.
If direct combined_receiver succeeds reliably but the simulator receiver does not, orchestration/tool context remains the dominant candidate bottleneck.

If the simulator receiver achieves at least 20/24 exact outputs with correct receipt and valid interaction, that is an eligibility signal for a separately preregistered message-format comparison on this narrow task, not evidence of protocol superiority.
If the model cannot load with the pinned 24-layer/8192-context settings, do not run scored inference; preregister an explicit hardware fallback and report the deviation first.
analysis: Report exact counts and denominators per length/condition, no inferential significance claim. Keep direct calls separate from simulator episodes. Report the 8B reference outcomes with model/checkpoint caveats; do not attribute differences to parameter count alone. Do not interpret token differences across models as a format efficiency result.
limits: one additional model checkpoint; family and training differ alongside size
task inputs are reused from v0.11-v0.15, so this is a capability follow-up rather than fresh task generalization evidence
CPU/GPU split may make latency unrepresentative of future optimized deployments
